exposure: Use of fetal pillow (yes vs. no)
Delivery at or below the level of the ischial spines
Use of fetal pillow device during full dilatation cesarean section
deliveries at or below the level of the ischial spines
outcome: Estimated blood loss (>1000 mL or >1500 mL)
cohort: 391 women who underwent full dilatation cesarean section between September 2014 and March 2018 at Liverpool Women's Hospital, UK
finding: The study found no statistically significant benefit from using the fetal pillow in preventing adverse maternal or fetal outcomes during full dilatation cesarean section.
mod_finding: While there was no overall benefit to fetal outcomes, the study found a reduced risk of arterial pH <7.1 in babies delivered at or below the ischial spines when the fetal pillow was used.
